name: a client that was started joins the world without a crash or a failed connect
note: Uses the lifecycle events (README, 'Lifecycle events'), so it needs a client started by puppet launch (puppet launch client, or with --server localhost:25565). It waits for client.connected and fails at once on any *.crash, *.connect_failed or a non-zero process.exited. Written from the scenario step's description in tools/puppet/scenario.js; NOT run against a game.
